title: Metronome Skill Definition
description: Schema for an oh-my-openagent-compatible custom skill file. Skills are SKILL.md files with YAML frontmatter, located in their own subdirectory.

name.description: Skill identifier. If omitted, defaults to the directory name.

description.description: What this skill does and when to use it. Include trigger phrases for auto-matching.
examples: Visual quality assurance for UIs. Triggers: 'visual QA', 'screenshot review'.

model.description: Override the default model for this skill only.

agent.description: Force a specific agent to execute this skill.

subtask.description: Run this skill in a subtask (separate session) instead of inline.

argument-hint.description: Hint shown to the user about what arguments to pass.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs. metadata.short-description is shown in skill listings.

short-description.description: One-line summary shown in compact listings.

mcp.description: MCP server definitions. Each server starts when the skill loads and stops when it unloads.

command.description: For stdio: the executable to run.

examples.name: metronome-validator
examples.description: Validates Chef d'orchestre installation. Triggers: 'validate metronome', 'check agents'.
